scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run build -w @email-client/web && dotnet publish apps/api-dotnet/ArchiveMail.Api/ArchiveMail.Api.csproj --configuration Release --output artifacts/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run build -w @email-client/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "dotnet watch --project apps/api-dotnet/ArchiveMail.Api/ArchiveMail.Api.csproj run" "npm run dev -w @email-client/web"
scripts.test: dotnet test apps/api-dotnet/ArchiveMail.Api.Tests/ArchiveMail.Api.Tests.csproj && npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run test:run -w @email-client/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run typecheck -w @email-client/web && dotnet build apps/api-dotnet/ArchiveMail.Api/ArchiveMail.Api.csproj
